completion_gate: The report names all fatal and nonfatal objections across the five separate checks.
Each IDEA record receives an explicit admissibility verdict (admit / require revision / reject) with a bounded falsification route for any admitted idea.
constraints: Independent session required; this review must not share lineage with either producer.

Separate checks: (1) receipt validity of both snapshots, (2) citation/source correctness, (3) IDEA schema completeness and object-first discipline, (4) matched-baseline correctness (does the idea actually challenge the stated baseline, or is the baseline mis-stated?), (5) novelty honesty.
Flag any idea whose mechanism does not name an exact object as underspecified; flag any idea whose matched baseline is missing or mis-stated as incomplete.
Change no producer artifact and no official state.
Record requested policy, resolved model identifier, fallback status, and session independence in review_report.yaml.
handoff.objective: Independently review (a) the KN-LIT-7617..7620 source filing for citation precision and honesty, and (b) the three IDEA records for schema completeness, object-first discipline, matched-baseline presence, falsifiability, and novelty honesty, and return a verdict on which ideas are admissible for experiment design.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the filed sources are the correct authoritative Round-3 artifacts and whether any proposed idea is worth carrying into experiment design, challenged from an independent session.

dispatches.title: Independent review of FAEST sources and ideation

objective: Open GOAL-FAEST-001 BATCH-001: obtain the Round-3 FAEST specification and reference implementation, file them as KN-LIT primary-source entries (the RQ-FAEST-001 constraint that no experiment be designed until the primary sources are filed), then run object-first ideation for RQ-FAEST-001 producing schema-complete IDEA-* proposals with the matched AES baseline cost written down. Proposals only: this batch creates no hypothesis, experiment, or evidence.
